description: Search DataCite DOI metadata for datasets, software, samples, workflows, and other research outputs. Combine plain words (`text`) or OpenSearch query syntax (`query`) with filters for resource type, creator (ORCID iD or name), affiliation (ROR ID or name), affiliation country, funder (ROR ID, Crossref Funder ID, or name), subject, field of science, repository, provider, license, language, geographic place, publication-year range, and minimum citation count. Returns the total match count and compact rows — DOI, title, first creators, year, type, repository, licenses, and citation/view/download counts — plus optional top facet counts. Page numbers reach the first 10,000 ranked matches; pass cursor "*" to walk any result set in full, in registration order.

affiliation.description: A ROR ID (021nxhr62 or a ror.org URL) — matches creator and contributor affiliations — or an affiliation name phrase.

affiliation_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of a creator or contributor affiliation, any case (DE, us). Alpha-3 codes and names are rejected.

creator.description: A creator ORCID iD (0000-0002-1825-0097, 16 digits, or an orcid.org URL; checksum verified) or a name — every name token must appear in one creator field.

cursor.description: Cursor walk over the full result set in registration order: "*" to start, then the nextCursor of the previous page, unchanged, with the same query and filters. Not with page or sort.

fields_of_science.description: OECD Fields of Science ids or labels (any match), e.g. computer_and_information_sciences or "Earth and related environmental sciences". List: datacite_list_reference topic fields_of_science.

funder.description: A funder ROR ID, a Crossref Funder ID (10.13039/100000001, its doi.org URL, or the bare digits), or a funder name.

include_child_funders.description: Also match the ROR funder's child organizations. Only with a ROR funder.

include_facets.description: Add top facet counts (resource types, years, repositories, providers, affiliations, fields of science, licenses). Adds 2–8 s.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the work, any case (en, de).

licenses.description: The work's own license ids (any match), e.g. cc-by-4.0, cc0-1.0, cc0 1.0, mit. Trimmed and lowercased, then matched exactly, preserving internal spaces; reuse ids from the licenses facet or datacite_list_reference topic licenses.

limit.description: Requested rows per page, 1–10,000; values above 100 apply 100 with a notice.

min_citations.description: Only works DataCite records at least this many citations for.

page.description: Ranked page number, 1 when omitted. page × limit may not exceed 10,000; not with cursor.

place.description: A geographic place phrase, matched against deposited place names.

provider_ids.description: Provider ids (any match), e.g. dryad — the providerId datacite_search_repositories returns. Any case.

published_from.description: Earliest publication year (inclusive). Alone, the range is open-ended.

published_to.description: Latest publication year (inclusive). Alone, the range is open-ended.

query.description: OpenSearch query-string syntax — field paths (titles.title:"…", creators.name:…, relatedIdentifiers.relationType:…), AND/OR/NOT, ranges, wildcards. Field paths: datacite_list_reference topic query_syntax. ANDed with text and the filters.

repository_ids.description: Repository ids (any match), shaped provider.repository — e.g. dryad.dryad or cern.zenodo — as datacite_search_repositories returns them in repositoryId. Any case.

resource_types.description: resourceTypeGeneral values (any match): dataset, software, computational-notebook, workflow, model, physical-object, … PascalCase accepted. Full list: datacite_list_reference topic resource_types.

sort.description: relevance, newest, oldest, recently_updated, most_cited, most_viewed, or most_downloaded. Omitted: relevance when text or query is set, else newest. Not with cursor.

subject.description: A subject phrase, matched case-insensitively against subject terms.

text.description: Plain words and phrases, searched literally: query-syntax characters are escaped, so "Climate change: impacts" works. Angle brackets are removed; nonblank text with no remaining searchable clause is rejected. Blank text is unset. Terms are ANDed.

name: datacite_search_works

appliedFilters.description: Every applied filter as sent upstream; {} when none.

affiliation.description: affiliation-id or affiliation-name clause as sent.

funder.description: funded-by or funder clause as sent.

effectiveQuery.description: The composed query string sent upstream.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_text`: Supplied nonblank text has no searchable literal clause after escaping. `invalid_query`: DataCite rejects the syntax of the query input (unbalanced parentheses or quotes, dangling operator). `invalid_filter`: A filter value is malformed: an ORCID iD failing its checksum, a ror.org or 10.13039/ value that is not a ROR ID or Crossref Funder ID, a language outside ISO 639-1, a creator or funder with no letters or digits, a reversed year range, or include_child_funders without a ROR funder. `page_ceiling`: page × limit exceeds 10,000, or the upstream reports a page other than the one requested. `invalid_cursor`: cursor is neither "*" nor an envelope this tool returned, belongs to a different query or filter set, or the upstream restarted the walk. `conflicting_paging`: cursor combined with page or sort. `rate_limited`: This deployment's shared DataCite request budget is spent: its request queue could not start a request before the call's deadline, or DataCite answered HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Top facet counts — only with include_facets.

id.description: Facet value id — the form the matching filter takes.
Facet value id — the form the matching filter takes.
Facet value id — the form the matching filter takes.
Facet value id — the form the matching filter takes.

Facet value id — the form the matching filter takes.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor, unchanged and with the same query and filters, to read the next page of a walk; absent on the last page.

nextPage.description: Next ranked page number, when more results lie within the 10,000 ceiling.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, paging stops short of the total, or the page is past the end.

rankedCeilingReached.description: True when ranked paging stops before all matches have been delivered; restart with cursor "*".

sortApplied.description: The sort order applied; a cursor walk is always oldest (registration order).

totalCount.description: Total works matching the query and filters.

citationCount.description: Citations DataCite records for this DOI. Absent when DataCite did not report it.

created.description: When the DOI record was created in DataCite (ISO 8601); the newest and oldest sorts and cursor walks order by it.

descriptionSnippet.description: First 300 characters of the abstract, else of the first description.

downloadCount.description: Downloads the repository reported. Absent when DataCite did not report it.

licenses.description: The work's own license ids; empty when none declared.

versionCount.description: Versions of this DOI. Absent when DataCite did not report it.

viewCount.description: Views the repository reported. Absent when DataCite did not report it.
